title: Booking an Event into the Diary: Conditions of Confirmation
content:
An event under Private Event & Banquet Services is confirmed into the diary against a date, a venue, a room set-up and an estimated contracted value, and the estimate is what every deposit and cancellation percentage is later applied to until a guarantee replaces it.

## 1. The agreement must stand active

A booking is only taken on an agreement that stands active, since an agreement on hold has had booking stopped and a proposed agreement has not yet been countersigned. The state relied on is the state the company's records carry against that agreement's own reference before the booking is taken, not the state the client reports.

## 2. Guest window and minimum spend

The following clause is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis: "The event must reach the minimum food and beverage spend printed against the package and sit between the smallest and largest guest counts printed against it; an event above the largest guest count is quoted on the next package up rather than squeezed into this one." The minimum food and beverage spend and the guest window printed against each package remain the figures of the package and are unchanged; what has been replaced is the handling that was built on them.

## 3. Room rental

Room rental is charged at the rate printed against the package and is waived in full once food and beverage spend reaches the waiver threshold printed against the same package; a partial waiver is never given.

## 4. Short-notice bookings, peak and blackout dates

A booking taken inside the booking lead time printed against the package is only confirmed where the kitchen and the room are both free, and where either is not, the next available date is offered rather than the event squeezed in. Events on declared peak dates carry the peak surcharge printed against the package, and events on published blackout dates are not booked at all.

## 5. Outside caterers and florists

Where the client brings in an outside caterer or florist, the preferred vendor fee printed against the package is charged on that vendor's invoice, and on packages where the fee is zero no such fee is raised.

## Boundary illustration on hypothetical figures

On a package whose waiver threshold is 12000, food and beverage spend of 12000 waives the rental in full and spend of 11999 leaves the whole rental standing; there is no half-way figure between the two.
